details: A US House proposal to strengthen the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and impose a 20-year holding rule is progressing. This move comes as US authorities increase their focus on cryptocurrencies used for sanctions evasion, particularly by Russia and Iran, aiming to make seized Bitcoin a long-term government asset. This initiative seeks to formalize Bitcoin's strategic status within federal reserves.
title: Trump's Bitcoin Reserve Bill Advances Amid US-Russia Tensions

details: The Federal Reserve has raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.75-4.00%, marking its first hike since July 2023. This decision is driven by persistent inflation risks, which are exacerbated by escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and a deepening energy crisis, pushing the US 10-year Treasury yield near 5%.
title: Fed Hikes Rates as Middle East Tensions Fuel Inflation Fears

details: The US Senate's Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act failed to pass a cloture vote, falling short of the 60 votes required to advance. In response, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has submitted its own comprehensive crypto market-structure rule package for White House review, indicating a move to establish cryptocurrency regulations using existing statutory authorities.
title: US CLARITY Act Fails, CFTC Advances Crypto Market Rules

details: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) has raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%, reaching its highest level in 31 years, in a move to address inflation risks. Despite the Japanese yen weakening against the US dollar following the decision, Bitcoin demonstrated notable resilience, climbing above $77,000.
title: BOJ Hikes Rates to 31-Year High; Bitcoin Rallies Above $77K
